name: unreadable-is-not-current
why: A target whose own state could not be read is unreadable, and it stays unreadable even where a door is open: an in-flight door tells you something is moving, and it does not tell you what the target carries underneath. The empty accepted string on an unreadable row is deliberate, so a surface prints nothing there rather than printing a version it never read.
